# HeadphonesAddict

> > Expert headphone and audio gear reviews since 2015, providing unbiased testing, buying guides, and comprehensive product comparisons across all audio categories.

HeadphonesAddict is a dedicated audio review platform offering in-depth evaluations of headphones, earbuds, and related audio equipment. The site features detailed product reviews using the proprietary Sonic9Score methodology, buying guides for different use cases, and technical guides on audio technology and troubleshooting.

## Key Topics

- Wireless Earbuds
- Over-Ear Headphones
- Active Noise Cancelling (ANC)
- Budget Headphones
- Gaming Headsets
- Sports Headphones
- Wired Headphones
- True Wireless Earbuds
- Bluetooth Technology
- Audio Testing
- Sonic9Score
- Product Reviews
- Buying Guides
- TOZO
- Apple AirPods

## Headphone Categories by Type

- [Over-Ear Headphones](https://headphonesaddict.com/over-ear): Over-ear headphones with latest features for immersive listening.
- [Wireless Headphones](https://headphonesaddict.com/bluetooth-headphones): Wireless headphones reviews for gym, work, and dynamic lifestyle.
- [Wired Headphones](https://headphonesaddict.com/wired): Wired headphones reviews for sound fidelity and reliable connection.
- [On-Ear Headphones](https://headphonesaddict.com/on-ear): On-ear headphones blending convenience and acoustic performance.
- [Open-Ear Headphones](https://headphonesaddict.com/open-ear): Open-ear air-conduction headphones for awareness and clarity.
- [Open-Back Headphones](https://headphonesaddict.com/open-back): Open-back headphones for natural sound and airy comfort.

## Specialized Audio Categories

- [Active Noise Cancelling](https://headphonesaddict.com/noise-cancelling): ANC headphone reviews, tests, and guides for noise removal.
- [Sports Headphones](https://headphonesaddict.com/sports-headphones): Sports headphones reviews evaluating fit, build, sweat protection.
- [Gaming: Headsets, Headphones & Earbuds](https://headphonesaddict.com/gaming): Gaming audio reviews for immersive experience and competitive edge.
- [Special, Unique Headphones](https://headphonesaddict.com/specific): Special headphones including cat ear, work, swimming MP3 sets.
